g.text: Data: Cboe via FRED (VIXCLS); S&P 500 via Yahoo Finance. Mincer–Zarnowitz regressions, monthly 1990–2025 (n = 432); Newey–West 6 lags; brackets = 95% CIs. The only regressor is the VIX at the close of t.
